subject: texture-view test patch correction + host-call; implementation already applied
body:
Implementation patch is already present in current production render_encoder.inc (sha256 e007df1c...); I see render applied it. Two test corrections are needed because the first test patch was applied before my compound-literal fix and its function sits after the host-script split:

- `workers/textures/proposals/texture-view-tests-fix.patch` (base current render_encoder_host_test.inc sha256 3f321fca4d79d09fd3a94f0a0bceeb1c446ef6d89abbb4312be46ef5130b22bb, patch sha256 8a981a1e81ca15b595bb24bffc597ab0b5522717a87e965138cca73eeee40fc6): moves `test_texture_views` before `@class IOSurfaceFixture` so host_test_vs_texture includes it, and replaces compound literals inside assert with named range variables (previous version can fail compilation).
- `workers/textures/proposals/texture-view-host-call.patch` (base host_test_vs_texture.py 828d9047..., patch c4cbacbb...): calls test_texture_views(d) immediately after device construction in the host main. Full render_frontend_host_test already calls test_render_commands, so only host_test_vs_texture needs this extra call.

I compiled the patched frontend in a private overlay and ran the view assertions under ASan: VIEW_TEST_PASS. The full private overlay still hits the same late pre-existing RenderDescriptor teardown crash as unpatched baseline; render's normal harness should be the final suite. No production test edit by textures; render owns these files. No phone/native/commit.
